Plot System Network

Source: R/system_network.R
rePredRet_plot_network.Rd

Network of the chromatographic systems with pre-built models. Each point is a system and each line a pair of systems with models between them.

Usage

rePredRet_plot_network(
  min_compounds = 20,
  layout_similarity = 0.4,
  interactive = FALSE,
  show_labels = FALSE,
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

min_compounds

Minimum shared compounds for a pair to count (default 20).

layout_similarity

Only links with at least this similarity (see Details) place the systems (default 0.4). All links are drawn.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly graph: hovering over a system shows its name, and a slider sets the minimum similarity of the links drawn.

show_labels

If TRUE, label each system with its ID (static plot only, default FALSE).

refresh

If TRUE, download fresh copies instead of using the cache.

Value

A ggplot object, or a plotly object if interactive = TRUE.

Details

The similarity of two systems is the Jaccard index of their compounds: shared compounds / compounds in either system. Unlike the number of shared compounds, it does not make every system look close to the few very large ones. Model sets published before systems.csv existed lack the number of compounds per system; it is then approximated by the most compounds the system shares with any other system.

The systems are placed by a force-directed layout (Fruchterman-Reingold) of the links with similarity of at least layout_similarity, plus each system's most similar link so that no system is left unconnected. All pairs with at least min_compounds shared compounds are then drawn, with width and opacity growing with their similarity, so that weak links fade into the background. Point size is the number of compounds in the system and shape the method type. The colours are groups of systems that share many compounds: Louvain communities of all pairs, weighted by similarity. The layout and the communities use a fixed seed.

Requires the igraph package.

See also

rePredRet_plot_system_matrix() for all pairs as a matrix.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rePredRet_plot_network()
rePredRet_plot_network(interactive = TRUE)
} # }
